\begin{example} \end{example}[A Polar Orthonormal Frame]

1. ch8:8.12The standard coordinate frame is a global orthonormal frame on $\mathbb {R}^n$. On $\mathbb {R}^2\setminus \{ 0\} $, with $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$, \[ E_1=\frac{x}{r}\frac{\partial }{\partial x} +\frac{y}{r}\frac{\partial }{\partial y},\qquad E_2=-\frac{y}{r}\frac{\partial }{\partial x} +\frac{x}{r}\frac{\partial }{\partial y}. \tag {8.3} \] This is an orthonormal frame; $E_1$ is radial and $E_2$ is tangent to centered circles. \end{example}
